map.需求价格弹性计算，预测价格变动对销量与收入的影响: Compute demand price elasticity and forecast the effect of a price change on volume and revenue
map.📖 查看「价格弹性系数 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Price Elasticity Coefficient User Guide"
map.中点法弧弹性 Ed=(ΔQ/均价Q)÷(ΔP/均价P)。|Ed|>1 富有弹性（: Midpoint arc elasticity Ed = (ΔQ / average Q) / (ΔP / average P). |Ed|>1 is elastic (cutting price raises revenue), <1 inelastic (raising price raises revenue) and ≈ 1 unit elastic. The result keeps its sign: a negative sign means a price rise cuts demand, which matches the usual demand law.
map.取绝对值判断：>1 富有弹性，<1 缺乏弹性，=1 单位弹性。: Judge by absolute value: >1 elastic, <1 inelastic and =1 unit elastic.
map.任何品类调价前估需求弹性。: Estimate demand elasticity before repricing any category.
map.用弹性判断该提价还是该促销。: Use elasticity to decide between a price increase and a promotion.
map.对比季节/竞品下的弹性变化。: Compare elasticity across seasons and competitors.
map.价格 200→180（−10%），销量 500→600（+20%）→ E=+20: Price 200 to 180 (−10%) with volume 500 to 600 (+20%) gives E = +20%/(−10%) = −2.0, elastic; revenue rises from 100000 to 108000, so the cut earns more.
map.价格 +10%、销量 −2% → E=−0.2 缺乏弹性，收入升 7.8%，适合: Price +10% with volume −2% gives E = −0.2, inelastic, and revenue rises 7.8%, which suits margin protection.
map.弹性会随价格区间变吗？: Does elasticity vary across price ranges?
map.会。低价区可能缺弹性、高价区变弹，宜在目标价位附近测算，勿外推过远。: It does. Demand may be inelastic at low prices and elastic at high prices, so measure near the target price and do not extrapolate too far.
map.没有历史数据怎么估？: How to estimate with no historical data?
map.可用小流量 A/B 实测两点价格的需求，再算局部弹性，比拍脑袋稳。: Run a small-traffic A/B test of demand at two price points and compute local elasticity, which is more reliable than guesswork.
